about: Keyboard and mouse bindings, plus controller combos where added (toggle: L3 + R3, both sticks pressed together; the game uses L3 and R3 alone, so each fires briefly too), read with PlayerController:IsInputKeyDown (keyboard, mouse and gamepad). Each entry in a combos list is one alternative; every key in a combo must be held. Controller: R2 is unused on foot (only turrets map it); L2 is the same game action as RMB (IA_LT_Tap_Char, aim) and R1 the same as R (IA_RB, gadget), both already blocked or flattened while Spidey is on. Keyboard/mouse keys are ones LEGO Batman's own mapping contexts leave unused (dumped from the 43 InputMappingContexts in the running game): RightMouseButton (aim) and MiddleMouseButton (gadget) are taken. Q and R (the player's choice) are LEGO Batman gadget keys, so Batman's gadget abilities are blocked while Spidey is on (see ability_blocks).
